title: Plan Manifest (orchestrator + plan-tree superset; canonical 6-state status)
description: Defines the ONE canonical 6-state `status` (retiring the legacy top_level_status field), the `sub_plans[]` master/sub aggregate, `graduation_timestamp`, `dependencies.{parallel_ok, blocks}`, and `paused_reason`; allows `rejected` in decision_records[].status; and carries the if/then type-binding (plan/master/sub-plan required-field shapes). additionalProperties:true permits forward-compatible field additions.

schema_version.description: Schema version. v1 accepts both `"1.0.0"` (legacy orchestrator manifests) and `1` (plan-tree manifests).

title.description: Human display name of the initiative — what a reader sees in rosters and indexes. Optional; readers fall back to `project` then the plan slug when absent.

project.description: Owning-spoke machine identity: the cwd-keyed spoke key (resolved through the anchored-spoke registry), used by robots to group, file, and drift-check plans. NOT the human display name — that is `title`. The home anchor resolves to the literal `home`.

spec_path.description: Absolute path to the spec.md file for this project

architecture_path.description: Absolute path to architecture.md, if one exists

status.description: The ONE canonical 6-state plan status. Vocabulary: researching -> planned -> in-progress <-> paused -> completed, with superseded terminal from any state. completed = the sole terminal done-state (the human's claim that work is done); close-out outputs (outcome_summary, shipped_artifacts, closed_at) survive as OPTIONAL fields, never a status gate. Archival is a display-only view filter over completed plans, not a status. Required on both type:plan and type:sub-plan manifests per the if/then binding below.

type.description: Manifest scope. plan = top-level plan; sub-plan = component under a plan; master = top-level coordinating manifest for multi-sub-plan initiatives. Sub-plan manifests carry sub-plan.

parent_plan.description: Top-level plan slug (no path, no extension). Required at depth ≥ 3 per CLAUDE.md plan-tree convention rule #5 (R-28). Plan-root files (depth 2) exempt; handoff.md exempt at any depth.

sub_plan_id.description: Two-digit ordinal of this sub-plan within its parent (01, 02, ...). Execution order, not creation order.

source_packet.description: Absolute path to the canonical alignment packet that locked this plan's scope.

phase_2_scaffolded_at.description: Date when /new-plan or /backlog-research scaffolded this plan tree.

updated.description: Date this manifest was last materially updated. Consumed by the librarian backlog-index read-replica (the Updated column, which falls back to phase_2_scaffolded_at when absent) and by backlog-hygiene staleness math. Seeded at every manifest-creation surface (new-plan scaffolder + promote-from-inbox) and maintained on material edits.

completed_at.description: Date the plan reached `completed` (date-only, matching the sibling `updated` convention). Stamped by the session-close chain on the in-progress->completed transition — once, when a completed plan is first observed without the field (idempotent; never overwritten). The archival display view-filter (plan-index default-hide) sorts on this date, falling back to `updated` for legacy manifests that predate the field.

disposition.description: Backlog triage disposition. Vocabulary mirrors governance/plans-rules.json :: backlog_row.disposition_enum (the SoT); consumed by the librarian backlog-index read-replica (the Disposition column, validated against that enum) and by backlog-hygiene (which stamps DEFERRED after the stale-advisory window).

superseded_by.description: Successor plan slug (no path, no extension) when status == superseded; else null/absent. A plain provenance field recording the successor, sourced from the program reconciliation ledger at superseding time.

promoted_from.description: Graduation provenance: the inbox idea-note ref (_inbox/<slug>.md) this plan was promoted from. Stamped by promote-from-inbox at graduation (the note itself is tombstoned — this field is the surviving record); consumed by the librarian backlog-index settled ledger (the graduated-row join). Declared here to codify long-standing behaviour — plain string, canonical _inbox/<slug>.md form.

absorbed_notes.description: Absorption provenance: inbox-note refs (canonical _inbox/<slug>.md form) this plan absorbed — the N:1 join the note-side absorbed_into: frontmatter cannot record from the plan side (a plan absorbing several notes previously had no structural record). Consumed by the librarian backlog-index settled ledger (one absorption-join row per listed note, landing plan named; a note-side settled row for the same note takes precedence).

id.description: Task identifier (T-1, T-2, ..., T-3.5 for inserts).

status.description: Task lifecycle state. This property is the SINGLE DECLARED HOME of the task-status vocabulary — the declared_vocabulary annotation below is the machine-readable roster and terminal/advanced split that vocabulary-keyed consumers key on. DELIBERATELY NON-ASSERTING (no type/enum/pattern keyword): three shipped validator sites hard-refuse on schema violations (tasks-render.sh, matrix-render.sh and subplan-aggregate.sh each construct Draft202012Validator(...).validate(manifest)), so an asserting constraint here would freeze replica renders over a typo'd or historical status — the same replica-staleness class the drift instrumentation exists to detect. Out-of-vocabulary values are FLAGGED (advisory), never refused: the write-time advisory validator lane and vocabulary-keyed consumers reading this declaration carry the flag; tasks.items stays permissive (additionalProperties true) by ruled contract.

declared_vocabulary.advanced_rule: The open-state list is CLOSED and every other value reads as ADVANCED: the live corpus carries settled free-form dispositions, so an advanced-side allowlist would refuse legitimate settled rows. An absent status key, empty string, or null-like token is OPEN. cut is ADVANCED and TERMINAL — deliberately-not-done, never counted as lagging.
declared_vocabulary.normalization: Classify on the normalized front token: substring before ' (', stripped, lowercased, underscores to hyphens — a narrated status like 'in-progress (slice closed)' classifies by its front token (the session-close.sh task_state contract).
declared_vocabulary.historical_tail_note: Values observed live in settled historical manifests, FROZEN: tolerated on read via the open_states/advanced_rule split, never used for new writes. New writes use the canonical roster. Converging historical rows is a live-corpus operation, deliberately outside the schema's reach.
declared_vocabulary.out_of_vocabulary_handling: A normalized front token outside canonical + open_states + historical_tail is OUT-OF-VOCABULARY: vocabulary-keyed consumers flag it as an advisory finding, never refuse the manifest. Under advanced_rule it still READS as advanced — which is exactly why the flag matters: a typo'd open status would otherwise silently read as settled.

dependencies.description: Plan-level dependency declarations. dependencies.{parallel_ok, blocks} express the first-class master/sub DAG alongside the predecessor/prereq fields.

parallel_ok.description: Sub-plan slugs that may run in PARALLEL with this (sub-)plan (no ordering constraint). Walked by the plan-runner DAG-walker.

blocks.description: Sub-plan slugs this (sub-)plan BLOCKS (they cannot start until this one reaches its gate). Walked by the plan-runner DAG-walker. NOTE R-63: a sub-plan must not declare a dependencies edge to a SIBLING sub — route cross-sub ordering through the master (sub-peer-isolation, advisory reconciler finding).

git_tag_published.description: PLAN-TREE FIELD. Per-tag publication record for foundation-repo distribution. Helper reads this object to evaluate R-55 sunset trigger conditions WITHOUT shelling to `git tag --list` (deterministic + fast).

sha.description: Commit SHA the tag points to.

live_mutation_scope.description: Plan-tree field. Declares a plan-scoped live-mutation gate. Plan-lifetime; retires when the plan closes via the three-phase sequence (Phase A parallel-run → Phase B helper retires → Phase C manifest entry retires).

inherits_from.description: Master plan slug for sub-plan manifests; null for top-level plans. Sub-plan declares ADDITIVE-ONLY scope: scope_paths/exempt_paths/launchd_labels/g2_commit_denylist UNION with master.

scope_paths.description: Glob patterns under which mutations gate. Each entry is an absolute-path glob; a trailing `/**` gates every file at any depth beneath the named directory.

exempt_paths.description: Post-detection carve-outs. Sub-plan can extend, NOT subtract. Generalizes the historical single hardcoded per-project-subtree carve-out into a declared list.

detection_signals.description: OR semantics — ANY one tier triggers DETECTED=1.

transcript_regex.description: Tier-3 fallback. OPT-IN ONLY. Locked to $CLAUDE_SESSION_ID at runtime (NOT find-mtime), so checkpoint resolution is deterministic rather than dependent on filesystem mtimes.

deterministic_only.description: If true, transcript_regex is disabled regardless of declaration.

override.description: Out-of-band override mechanisms. NO in-band fields permitted (e.g., bypass: true is schema-rejected). Underscore-prefixed annotation keys (^_) are permitted (inert rationale notes); the closed-world gate still rejects any real unknown field such as bypass.

nonce_sha_anchor.description: Git ref (tag or branch) whose SHA must equal the third tab-separated field of the nonce content.

nonce_consume_strategy.description: LOCKED to (c) both = basename-match-env primary + scope carve-out. first_match_glob is DEPRECATED.

nonce_affinity_env.description: Env var name caller sets to indicate which nonce basename to match (e.g., PLAN_71_NONCE_TASK).

bypass_env_var.description: Shell-rc-only escape hatch. Per-call env scoping in Claude Code prevents agent self-issuance.

layer_3.description: L3 writer-pause declarations (per-plan write-pause windows), validated at manifest-author time.

expected_quiescence_period_seconds.description: k8s drain pattern; helper sleeps this duration after pause-broadcast. Default 30s.

pause_via.description: v1 mechanism for UserPromptSubmit writers (no native pause API).

g2_commit_denylist.description: Path globs added to the guarded repository's `.git/hooks/pre-commit` denylist for the duration of this plan's gate.

match_action.description: deny=block+log; warn=log+advisory+ALLOW (new-plan onboarding soak); dryrun=log only, no user-visible message, ALLOW (pre-deploy validation).

error_action.description: deny=fail-closed on helper crash (default; security-gate posture); ignore=fail-open (Phase A bootstrap exception ONLY).

sunset.description: Plan retirement state machine. Three explicit phases A→B→C.

trigger_conditions.description: ALL must hold for retirement eligibility.

deferral_until.description: Explicit calendar gate. e.g., "2026-05-17" for R-55.

phase.description: Current phase. A=parallel-run; B=helper retired, manifest entry active; C=manifest entry retired.

teardown_status.description: Coarse retirement marker for human-readable status. Inherits the r55_sunset.teardown_status semantics.

harness_validated.description: PLAN-TREE FIELD. Verdict-pass entries from the dogfood-harness. The verdict gate (foundation-repo .git/hooks/pre-commit) refuses a sub-plan canonical status flip from in-progress → completed unless a matching verdict-pass entry exists at current foundation-repo HEAD within last 7 days. Cross-sub-plan invalidation via post-commit hook when a sister sub-plan modifies files in a validated sub-plan's live_mutation_scope.scope_paths.

sha.description: Foundation-repo HEAD SHA at run time.

judges.description: LLM judges if verdict ensemble used.

pinned_reference_v.description: Pinned reference version against which the harness ran.

tier.description: Tier-1 = structural assertion (pass/fail deterministic); tier-2 = behavioral assertion (judge-mediated); tier-3 = soft observability (advisory).

evidence_path.description: Path to harness output artifacts (logs, diffs, screenshots).

harness_freshness.description: Freshness band relative to current foundation-repo HEAD. The verdict gate accepts only `fresh` for the canonical status flip.

decision_records.description: PLAN-TREE FIELD. Pointer array to the plan's ADR ledger at <plan>/decisions/ADR-NN-<slug>.md. Optional — absent on plans with no recorded decisions; existing manifests remain valid (not required; additionalProperties:true). Body-structure contract: governance/file-type-contracts/adr.md.json. Convention: governance/plans-rules.json :: decision_records. The status enum is reconciled to the MADR-canonical set with `rejected` added; paired with the plans-rules.json :: decision_records convention + governance/file-type-contracts/adr.md.json under R-37 documentary lockstep. Agent-reload contract: on plan resume, load non-superseded ADRs via this manifest.decision_records[] pointer.

id.description: ADR ordinal identifier. Matches the id pattern; immutable once published.

status.description: Bare lifecycle token (MADR-canonical {proposed, accepted, rejected, deprecated} + superseded). `rejected` is included beyond the base MADR set. The ADR file's **Status:** line carries the concrete superseded-by-ADR-NN form; the pointer's superseded_by field carries the target.

path.description: Plan-relative or absolute path to the ADR file (e.g., decisions/ADR-NN-<slug>.md).

superseded_by.description: ADR ordinal that supersedes this record, when status == superseded; else null/absent.

research_artifacts.description: PLAN-TREE FIELD. Pointer array to the plan's declared research SoT — one entry per durable research artifact a plan produces (landing under <plan>/_research/). Optional — absent on plans with no recorded research; existing manifests remain valid (not required; additionalProperties:true). This is the declared-artifact roster the binder projections consume: a research-class entry projects to one research-index row (path / type / status / plan-origin / one-liner plus a Library column derived from library_refs); a decision-class entry (resolved kind decision|adr — declared `type` wins, else filename-stem inference) projects on the decision log's Decision-artifacts section instead, deduped against the same plan's decision_records[] paths. Declaration is the selectivity gate — only declared artifacts earn a row. Body-structure contract: governance/file-type-contracts/library-article.md.json. Consumers MUST treat a missing field as empty, never an error (legacy manifests carry none).

id.description: Stable artifact identifier within the plan (e.g., RA-01, RA-02, ...).

status.description: Lifecycle token. `active` = in progress; `finalized` = settled, eligible for library promotion; `deferred` = paused/parked.

path.description: Plan-relative or absolute path to the research artifact (e.g., _research/memory-survey.md).

type.description: Optional artifact KIND (kind-driven projection routing). A declared type always wins over the generators' filename-stem inference. Decision-class kinds (`decision`, `adr`) project on the binder decision-log's Decision-artifacts section; every other kind (e.g. `research`, `survey`, `synthesis`, `ideation-brief`) projects on the research index. Open vocabulary (free string, not an enum) — an unknown kind routes to the research index.

session.description: Session number/identifier that produced or last touched this artifact.

library_refs.description: Library articles this research promoted into, in <topic>/<article> form (the bidirectional stamp partner of the article's originating_plan back-pointer). Drives the research-index Library column. Empty/absent until promotion.

research_closed.description: PLAN-TREE FIELD. Optional anti-scope marker. When true, plan-research-declare STOPS auto-appending newly-discovered artifacts to research_artifacts[] and instead emits a research-declare-closed-scope finding for human adjudication — a plan whose research scope is closed no longer ratifies a misplaced durable artifact by mere presence in a scanned research dir. Setter convention: research_closed is stamped true by the sanctioned close-out flow when a plan reaches terminal status ({completed, superseded}); the operator may hand-set it on active plans; plan-research-declare only reads it; plans being rehomed by the durable-artifact census are never bulk-stamped. Optional — absent/false is the default (the append path is unchanged); additionalProperties:true keeps legacy manifests valid.

_top_level_status_retired._note: The legacy 5-state top_level_status field [aligned, in_progress, complete, closed, superseded] is RETIRED and replaced by the single canonical `status` field above. Consumers re-point top_level_status -> status (the verdict gate and spec-context-inject, which re-keys on status==in-progress). harness_validated[] descriptions referencing top_level_status flips are read as `status` flips post-retirement.

paused_reason.description: The structured reason a `paused` plan carries (paused replaces on-hold). Top-level enum, 5 values from observed usage patterns. Set when status==paused; advisory when status != paused.

graduation_timestamp.description: The timestamp stamped when this (sub-)plan reaches a terminal status ({completed, superseded}); the librarian reconciler READS it into the master sub_plans[] aggregate (sub-publishes-upward, R-62); null until then.

sub_plans.description: The master's pull-based DERIVED read-replica of its sub-plans' status (same trust class as _index.md; NEVER hand-edited — written by the librarian reconciler reading each sub's published status, R-61). Present on type:master manifests; a master aggregates sub STATUS not sub TASKS (a master may carry an empty tasks[]).

sub_plan_id.description: Two-digit ordinal of the sub-plan (01, 02, ...; execution order).

status.description: The sub-plan's status — a DERIVED mirror (by-copy) of the sub's OWN canonical 6-state status; the master never overwrites it, the librarian aggregator reads each sub's published status into this read-replica. The vocabulary is the SAME canonical 6-state set as the top-level status field above; the upgrade migration converges any legacy read-replica still carrying a pre-collapse token, so a validated master mirror never carries a retired status. The master display logic coarsens this to the pending/active/done buckets.

graduation_timestamp.description: Copied from the sub's graduation_timestamp when published upward.
